beats.intent: Promise three things about the CATEGORY, not about the product. The number must match the beats that follow. No product name.
beats.example: שלושה דברים שאת חייבת לדעת על טיפוח פנים

beats.intent: A genuine, useful tip about the category that the product happens to satisfy. Written as advice, not as a feature. Lead with the noun.
Second genuine tip. Keep the clause shape parallel to the first — the parallelism is the rhythm.
beats.example: שתיים, אם זה לא מתאים לסוג העור שלך זה סתם בזבוז

beats.intent: Third and strongest tip. Still advice about the category, still no product name.
beats.example: ושלוש, איכות אמיתית לא חייבת לבוא על חשבון הסביבה

beats.intent: Name the product as the one option that satisfies all three tips, then stop. Two to five words of close at most.
beats.example: המוצר היחיד שמצאתי שעושה את שלושתם נקרא עולא ביוטי, הלינק למטה

notes: The tips must be real category advice the viewer could act on without buying anything — that is what earns the recommendation at the end. Listing three product features instead is the failure mode. Tight on words: five beats against the budget, so keep every clause short.
